latin: Ipseitas uniuscuiusque tunc maxime est ipsa, cum in ipsa ita sunt omnia, ut in ipsa omnia sint ipsa.
translation: The selfhood of each and every thing is most fully itself precisely when all things exist within it in such a way that, within it, all things are itself.
translation_note: 'ipseitas' = selfhood/self-identity, a scholastic coinage; sense checked.
